description: Write the construct as it is open now (unsaved edits included) as GenBank into the workspace's .dnagent/snapshots folder and return the path, for analysis with the dnagent CLI.
name: export_snapshot

description: All features of an open construct (current state, unsaved edits included), as `dnagent features --output json` rows.
name: get_features

description: What the user is looking at: the active construct, view tab, selected base range and selected feature (as a `dnagent features` row). "This", "here" or "the selection" refer to these.
name: get_view

description: Every open construct in tab order: id, name, length, topology, whether it is the active tab, unsaved changes and edit_counter.
name: list_documents

description: Show a short message to the user in the app's agent panel, e.g. progress or a question to answer in the terminal.
name: notify

description: Open a construct file (.dna, GenBank, FASTA, .locus.json) in the app as a new tab, or switch to it if it is already open. Use an absolute path (~/ is expanded). Returns its document_id once the app shows it.

path.description: absolute path of the file to open

name: open_file

description: Present a finished result: open the file (e.g. an assembled product written as GenBank), show the summary in the app's agent panel and list the highlights (junctions, primer sites, new features) for the user to click; the first highlight is selected. Use at the end of autonomous work.

HighlightArg.description: A region to highlight in `present` (half-open; end < start wraps on circular records).

label.description: Short name shown to the user, e.g. "5' junction" or "F primer".

highlights.description: regions to point out, in order of importance

path.description: absolute path of the result file to open

summary.description: what was done and what to check, in one or two sentences

name: present

description: Select a feature (by its id from get_features) and make its construct the active tab. Returns the resulting view.
name: select_feature

description: Select a base range in an open construct and make it the active tab, to show the user a region. Zero-based, half-open [start, end); end < start wraps through the origin on circular constructs. Returns the resulting view.
name: select_range

description: The app version, workspace folder and how many constructs are open.
name: status
